tasks_completed.description: Added merge_agent_slots() to scripts/lib/json_io.py (key-level day merge)
tasks_completed.changes: New function merge_agent_slots(existing_data, update_data, agent_name). For each update_day, locates matching existing_day by day number; overlays update_day's keys onto existing_day via dict.update() so only keys present in the update are replaced. Named-slot agents (meals, accommodation) get per-slot overwrite; array-based agents (attractions, entertainment, shopping, cafe) get whole-array replacement per key. Days in existing but not referenced by update pass through. Days in update but absent from existing are inserted. Trip-level metadata preserved via existing_data.copy().
tasks_completed.rationale: Root cause: merge_agent_days performed full day-object replacement (existing_days_map[day_num] = update_day), which silently wipes sibling keys on partial-day updates. This is correct for the timeline agent but wrong for POI agents. Per BA Contract C (tier_2_verified), a NEW function was required -- do not alter merge_agent_days semantics.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A (logic deficiency, not a regression). Confirmed data-loss incident at commit 47fccd4 (2026-04-13 13:14): data/china-20260412-092624/meals.json Day 2 breakfast + lunch silently wiped by a meals-agent run that updated only dinner.
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: merge_agent_days() in scripts/lib/json_io.py:367 performed `existing_days_map[day_num] = update_day`, a full day-object replacement. This was designed for the timeline agent (whole-day recalculation is correct there) and then reused unchanged for POI agents whose save payloads contain only the slot(s) the agent updated. Every partial-day POI save therefore destroyed all un-emitted keys on that day.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Introduces a parallel merge function, merge_agent_slots(), that uses dict.update() at the day level -- only keys present in the update are written; keys absent from the update survive. Gated behind a new --merge-slots CLI flag so the original --merge-days / merge_agent_days path is untouched for the timeline agent. All six POI agent prompts are switched to the new flag.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: Actual feature code is ~60 lines (merge_agent_slots body + save.py wiring + 6 prompt edits). The remaining ~165 lines modified are the forced refactor of save_agent_batch/validate_agent_data/_atomic_write -- required by the project's pretool-quality-gate hook (max nesting depth 3), which blocked every Edit to json_io.py until depth-4 regions in pre-existing code were flattened. Refactored behavior is identical to pre-refactor. New-file totals (586 lines) are the BA-requested audit script (R11) and integration tests (R14), both explicitly in scope.
